== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Emala]], known as the Rune [[Queen]], was a powerful figure who died during the [[Dread War]]. During her lifetime, she functioned in a defensive capacity during major conflicts and was capable of relocating structures like [[Shatterspine Castle]]. Her magical [[Path]], known as the [[Path of Last Oath|Path of the Last Oath]], utilizes various [[aspects]] including force and [[water]]. She left behind a significant legacy through her complex scripting patterns and the [[Grand Oath Array]], a masterpiece that can manipulate reality and even slow time. Her influence persists through various means, such as [[the Queen]]'s Gift—a divine treasure that allows others to utilize her political and conceptual [[Authority|authority]]—and various silver sigils and [[scripts]]. Her remaining works and arrays are central to efforts involving the reconstruction of her lost technologies.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Rune [[Queen]] possesses a powerful [[madra]] that clashes with the [[madra]] of [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]. Additionally, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] is currently conducting experiments involving the array belonging to the Rune [[Queen]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Rune [[Queen]] possessed a powerful [[madra]] that could be consumed and vented, though it clashed with the [[madra]] of [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]. Her influence included the provision of silver runes and a [[Script|script]] containing a [[dragon]] [[Remnant]]. After moving [[Shatterspine Castle]], she departed from the castle and died shortly thereafter.}}
